tools.name: search_connectors
tools.description: Search the grokbot.tools directory of MCP connectors and plugins for Grok Bot by name, service or category, with optional filters (Grok Bot test status, install method, auth type). Returns compact summaries with the install method, auth type, honest test-status label and the grokbot.tools page URL;

tools.name: get_connector
tools.description: Get the full public record for one published connector by its slug (the last part of https://grokbot.tools/connectors/{slug}): summary, install method with step-by-step instructions and sources, MCP URL (null for built-in plugins), auth type, docs link, Grok Bot test status with the last test date,

tools.name: list_connectors
tools.description: Page through every published connector in the grokbot.tools directory, alphabetically, with the same optional filters as search_connectors. Returns compact summaries plus the total, the categories in use (first page), and a next_cursor to pass back for the next page. Use this when you want the whole

tools.name: list_requests
tools.description: List the grokbot.tools wishlist: apps people want connected to Grok Bot, sorted by on-site votes or by newest. Each item has its status (requested, claimed, live), on-site vote count, the labeled seed signal ('X buzz (seed)', mentions elsewhere that are never counted as votes), a linked connector if

tools.name: get_request
tools.description: Get one wishlist request by slug (the last part of https://grokbot.tools/requests/{slug}): status, on-site votes, the labeled seed signal, description, public sources (links to the posts it came from), the linked connector if one exists, the builder if it has been claimed, and a matching setup guide

tools.name: how_to_add_connector
tools.description: Explains how an app gets into Grok Bot: built-in plugins (Connect apps in the sidebar), custom MCP servers (you ask the Bot in chat to add a URL; must be public HTTPS using streamable HTTP or SSE), and the browser-only route when neither exists.
